title: Offline dry run of the bios pipeline and $0 baseline replay
description:
## Purpose

Prove the whole bios pipeline offline and reproduce the free rows from cache before any spend.

## Scope

Dry run of comments, rounds 1-3 for all arms and the final through reloaded bundles with fake engines; $0 replay of baselines from cached Jev answers; the gate prints the exact request counts for every live stage; planted-bias replays still pass.

## Definition of done

Dry-run summaries and gate counts posted as a comment with the exact live commands; every live stage's gate count within its cap. Cost: $0.
